secrets.principle: NEVER persist plaintext broker credentials in repo, database, or logs.
secrets.mechanism: TradeLockerAuthProvider resolves credentials at call time from an injected secret_provider keyed by REFERENCE names (email_ref/password_ref/server/developer_api_key_ref).
secrets.repo_scan: credentials appear ONLY as fake test values inside test fixtures and FakeTradeLocker defaults (user@example.com / s3cret). No real credential values exist anywhere in the tree.
secrets.log_rule: tokens never logged; auth failures log status + truncated body only

connectivity.network_in_tests: ZERO — FakeTradeLocker implements the transport protocol in-process; tests never open sockets

write_surface.submit_order: gated by local preflight (order_check) + provider route validity + validity mapping; ambiguous sends NEVER retried; acceptance != fill
write_surface.close_position: places closing ORDER only; flatness must be confirmed via positions truth
write_surface.rate_limiter: bounded retries; no infinite retry; order POST retry policy conservative (no blind resend after timeout)
